sourceEvidence.title: Production Supervisor
sourceEvidence.quote: Summary Are you a hands-on leader who’s passionate about building strong teams and delivering high-quality results? We’re looking for a collaborative and solution-oriented Production Supervisor to help guide and grow a skilled team within our manufacturing operations. In this role, you’ll take ownership of your department and work cross-functionally to drive improvements in quality, efficiency, and safety, all while supporting the development of the people on your team. This is your opportunity to make a real impact, not just on the shop floor, but on the future of the business. This role oversees our Second Shift , providing critical leadership during key production hours. What You’ll Do: Lead and coach a team of production employees, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and growth Oversee daily production schedules to ensure on-time delivery and product quality Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean tools, targeting at least 25% of your time on process enhancements Champion safety by identifying risks, implementing solutions, and ensuring compliance with OSHA and company standards Reduce costs through resource planning, inventory control, scrap reduction, and overtime management Monitor attendance, performance, and training needs, providing regular feedback and development opportunities Maintain high standards for organization and cleanliness using 5S methodology Troubleshoot equipment and process issues as needed to keep operations running smoothly Partner cross-functionally to remove production roadblocks and elevate performance What You Bring: 2–5 years of supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment High school diploma or GED required; technical certifications a plus Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop others Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing concepts (e.g., Kaizen, 5S, visual management) Proficiency with Microsoft Office; ERP experience (SAP preferred) Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical documentation Willingness to work flexible shifts, including occasional weekends or overtime Physical Requirements: Abili
